text:
Predicates:
Contains(x) ::: x contains knowledge.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x is smarter.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is authored by z.
Title(y, t) ::: y has title t.
Premises:
Books contain tons of knowledge.
Reads(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
GainsKnowledge(x) ← Reads(x, y) ::: A person gains knowledge if they read a book.
Smarter(x) ← GainsKnowledge(x) ::: A person becomes smarter if they gain knowledge.
Contains(walden) ::: Walden contains knowledge.
Conclusion:
Contains(walden) ::: Walden contains knowledge.
